why: Lane B enumerates small heaps first (exec/korat.mjs): every assignment of the record shapes' reference fields and arguments over a pool of two objects per shape, one representative per non-isomorphic graph. writeThenRead reads the second leaf after or before writing the first: equal unless the two arguments are one object, which the enumeration supplies as its first inputs; lane A withholds the value-reading lemma (two input positions of one shape, a write through one: the identity guard's aliasing class). length walks a list: equal on every chain, different on a cycle (the parent stops at the first repeat, the candidate at 64), which the enumeration supplies too. total is read-only and commutative: proved by lane A, bounded by lane B.
